xmldoc.short_description: Create push button or state button component.

param_input_item.param_description: figure created with uifigure, or figure graphics object.
property name: a scalar string or row vector character.
property value: a value compatible with property name.

description.p: btn = uibutton creates a push button in a new figure and returns the Button object. Nelson calls the uifigure function to create the figure.

btn = uibutton(style) creates a button of the specified style: 'push' creates a push button (Button object, ButtonPushedFcn callback), 'state' creates a state button (StateButton object, with a boolean Value and a ValueChangedFcn callback).
btn = uibutton(parent) creates the button in the specified parent container.

btn = uibutton(..., propertyName, propertyValue) specifies properties as one or more name-value arguments: Text, Icon, IconAlignment, HorizontalAlignment, VerticalAlignment, WordWrap, FontName, FontSize, FontWeight, FontAngle, FontColor, BackgroundColor, Enable, Visible, Tooltip, Position, ButtonPushedFcn (push), Value and ValueChangedFcn (state), ...

example_item.example_item_description: Captured UI component for the help image.

example_item.example_item_data: f = uifigure(); btn = uibutton(f, 'Text', 'Click me', 'Position', [100 100 100 22], 'ButtonPushedFcn', @(src, event) disp('pushed'))
f = uifigure(); sb = uibutton(f, 'state', 'Text', 'Enable option', 'Value', true)
